mapper.select: -- 전체 집합을 지문으로 반환한다. 분할 크기를 전체 LIMIT로 적용하지 않으며 HTTP 요청도 없다. WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED () SELECT count(1) AS candidate_count,encode(digest(coalesce(string_agg( encode(digest(jsonb_build_array(source_id,ordinal,input_hash,provider_code)::text,'sha256'),'hex'),'' ORDER BY ordinal),''),'sha256'),'hex') AS candidate_hash FROM candidates
-- REPEATABLE READ에서 대기 후 오래된 snapshot을 사용하는 대신 처리 중인 동일 요청에 재조회 안내를 반환한다. SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),74001))
mapper.sql: id AS run_id,policy_id,scope_json::text AS scope_json,policy_snapshot_json::text AS policy_snapshot_json, scope_hash,candidate_hash,candidate_count,segment_size,segment_count,deleted_item_count,row_version,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash,created_at
mapper.select: -- 최초 입력으로만 같은 전체 목록을 재조회한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_runs WHERE idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 원문을 제외한 고정 관리 기록. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_runs WHERE id=#{runId}
-- 페이지 제한은 고정 run 목록 조회에만 적용한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- 고정 run 전체 수. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_runs

-- 최초 분모·분할·삭제·실제 잔여 목록을 독립 대조한다. SELECT (SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_items WHERE run_id=#{runId}) AS remaining_item_count, count(1) AS segment_count,coalesce(sum(item_count),0)::bigint AS initial_segment_item_count, coalesce(sum(deleted_item_count),0)::bigint AS deleted_segment_item_count FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_segments WHERE run_id=#{runId}
mapper.sql: s.run_id,s.segment_no,s.item_count,s.deleted_item_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_items i WHERE i.run_id=s.run_id AND i.segment_no=s.segment_no) AS remaining_item_count
mapper.select: -- run 소유 관계를 확인한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_segments s WHERE s.run_id=#{runId} AND s.segment_no=#{segmentNo}
mapper.insert: -- 목록 고정은 job 생성/외부 수집/현재 판정 적용이 아니다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_backfill_runs(id,policy_id,scope_json,policy_snapshot_json,scope_hash,candidate_hash, candidate_count,segment_size,segment_count,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash) VALUES (#{runId},#{policyId},CAST(#{scopeJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{policySnapshotJson} AS jsonb),#{scopeHash},#{candidateHash}, #{candidateCount},#{segmentSize},#{segmentCount},#{requestedBy},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash})
mapper.select: -- 동일 snapshot의 전체 순번으로 분할을 만든다. count를 bigint로 받아 JDBC update count 상한과 구분한다. WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_backfill_segments(run_id,segment_no,item_count) SELECT #{runId},(ordinal-1)/#{scope.segmentSize}+1,count(1)::integer FROM candidates GROUP BY (ordinal-1)/#{scope.segmentSize}+1 RETURNING run_id) SELECT count(1) FROM inserted

-- scope-preview와 같은 전체 집합. source/content/base/rule은 삭제 cascade 가능한 관계로만 보관한다. WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_backfill_items(run_id,segment_no,ordinal,source_id,content_version_id,base_evaluation_id,rule_release_id,provider_code,input_hash) SELECT #{runId},(ordinal-1)/#{scope.segmentSize}+1,ordinal,source_id,content_version_id,base_evaluation_id,rule_release_id,provider_code,input_hash FROM candidates RETURNING run_id) SELECT count(1) FROM inserted
